text: On the person's word of 2026-11-17 (docs/ideas/20261117.md; c7e2552): the root CLAUDE.md now reads 'a quantity that enters a card or a decision of the agent is computed by a library skill, and a value the engine itself reports is read from the engine and not computed again'; contracts/skill_kinds.json adds estimate (a setup value or a run's cost from a relation; it may give the quantities one relation ties, so a relation and its inverse are one skill) and diagnostic (the state of a run or a measurement judged by a criterion it is handed; undecided without one; it holds no criterion). Check 22 asks two worked cases with differing inputs of each, and of a diagnostic a state output and a case expecting undecided. Examples on unrelated kinds: contracts/examples/skills/estimate/box_length_for_volume_fraction@v1 (a simulation box, taking the particle's volume), estimate/scans_for_signal_to_noise@v1 (an instrument's acquisition), diagnostic/series_settled@v1 (an engine's acceptance and a sample's temperature). build-library-skill now says which skill to make: from what the built agent decides while it runs and from test failure lines, named for the relation and not the request's object. What was measured: the three HOOMD-blue bundles' standalone sessions ran the skill runner zero times and the tool runner fifteen; the four HOOMD-blue skills were the tutorial's setup arithmetic, named for its octahedron and lattice. Asked of the meta role: in the next template, a bundle's CLAUDE.md names, for each decision its workflow takes at run time (settled, acceptance in its window, the trend of a count), the diagnostic skill it runs and the row that hands its criterion; and the HOOMD-blue skills of the next build are written as estimate and diagnostic skills under these rules, with the engine's own reported values read from the engine. A collection now counts the library skills each bundle session ran, so the next standalone test shows whether they are used.
